titles.native: ガールズフィスト!!!! GT

description:
Girls' Fist!!!! GT, the manga branch of the Girls' Fist!!!! media mix project, is getting animated! Starting today, the project's official YouTube channel will air a 13-episode short anime.

The story is set in Matsumoto City, Nagano Prefecture, and centers on four high school girls who form a band to fulfill their dream of performing on stage at a music festival.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)
